# NEW 2026-11-23 v17.5 Golden Horde 5-Wing Ulus Logistics & Winter Garrison Guard (oe_v175m_). Generated by gen_v175_map_consolidation.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# O(1) yearly kernel hook (invoked once per calendar year from oe_gk_yearly_dispatch).
# Self-deduplicates via global_var:oe_v175m_ran_y ?= current_year, checks only c:GLH and
# its 5 starting Ulus wings (WHO, SBR, KHW, KZN, CRI) directly — zero every_country sweeps,
# zero debug_log.
oe_v175m_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_v175m_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v175m_ran_y value = current_year }

		# One-time Day-1 / first-year treasury & winter garrison kit for active Jochid wings
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v175m_init }
				country_exists = c:GLH
				c:GLH = { is_rebel_country = no }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v175m_init value = 1 }
			oe_v175m_init_ulus_wing = { tag = WHO }
			oe_v175m_init_ulus_wing = { tag = SBR }
			oe_v175m_init_ulus_wing = { tag = KHW }
			oe_v175m_init_ulus_wing = { tag = KZN }
			oe_v175m_init_ulus_wing = { tag = CRI }
		}

		# Yearly O(1) steppe grain & upkeep guard for loyal oe_glh_ulus wings
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:GLH
				c:GLH = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					is_subject = no
				}
			}
			oe_v175m_guard_ulus_wing = { tag = WHO }
			oe_v175m_guard_ulus_wing = { tag = SBR }
			oe_v175m_guard_ulus_wing = { tag = KHW }
			oe_v175m_guard_ulus_wing = { tag = KZN }
			oe_v175m_guard_ulus_wing = { tag = CRI }
		}
	}
}

# One-time starting treasury reserve (180 gold) + 15-year steppe garrison logistics modifier.
oe_v175m_init_ulus_wing = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:$tag$
			c:$tag$ = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject_of = c:GLH
			}
		}
		c:$tag$ = {
			add_gold = 180
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_v175m_ulus_garrison_mod
				years = 15
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
}

# Yearly anti-bankruptcy & winter forage floor for active oe_glh_ulus wings under c:GLH.
oe_v175m_guard_ulus_wing = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:$tag$
			c:$tag$ = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject_of = c:GLH
				is_subject_type = oe_glh_ulus
			}
		}
		c:$tag$ = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
					gold < 60
				}
				add_gold = 45
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v175m_ulus_garrison_mod }
					OR = {
						gold < 80
						at_war = yes
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_v175m_ulus_garrison_mod
					years = 2
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
